name: io.github.SmarthomeNinja/myio-mcp
title: myIO
description: Read and control a myIO smart home controller: heating, lighting, blinds and energy.

environmentVariables.name: MYIO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of the myIO controller, e.g. http://192.168.1.178

environmentVariables.name: MYIO_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: myIO user name; its permission level limits what the tools can do

environmentVariables.name: MYIO_WRITE
environmentVariables.description: Write level: state (switch only), config (also settings) or admin

environmentVariables.name: MYIO_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool groups to load, e.g. house,automation (default: all)

environmentVariables.name: MYIO_SERVERS
environmentVariables.description: Several controllers: JSON array of {name, url, username, password}; overrides the three above
